faq.title: Virtual Cards FAQs
faq.q1: Are Getly virtual cards accepted worldwide?
faq.a1: Yes, Getly virtual cards work across international online merchants, travel platforms, and digital subscription services.
faq.q2: Can I freeze my card if I misplace my device?
faq.a2: Yes, you can freeze and unfreeze any virtual card with a single tap in your Getly security dashboard.

capabilities.title: Instant Generation & Total Control
capabilities.subtitle: Create virtual cards in seconds right from your smartphone. Use them everywhere online payment cards are accepted with real-time spending notifications.

item1.title: Instant card creation with custom spending limits
item1.desc: Generate a new virtual card in seconds, and set your own spending limit on it — so every card only ever has the power to spend exactly what you allow.

item2.title: One-tap card freeze and unfreeze
item2.desc: For complete peace of mind, freeze any card the moment something feels off, then unfreeze it just as fast the moment you're ready to spend again.

item3.title: Accepted by merchants everywhere
item3.desc: Use your Getly card across online stores and flight bookings worldwide, wherever payment cards are accepted.

item4.title: Funded straight from your wallet
item4.desc: No separate top-up step. Every virtual card draws instantly from your Getly wallet balance the moment you spend.

step2.title: Fund it from your wallet
